name: The Hobbit Game
source:
It is simply a labour of love to experience, in a small way, the excitement that Bilbo must have faced as he had a riddle battle for his life in a dark cavern inside a mountain. 
[From [url=https://davidhepting.itch.io/the-hobbit-game] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
比尔博在山中的一个黑暗洞穴中为自己的生命进行一场谜语之战时，以一种小小的方式体验比尔博必须面对的兴奋，这只是一种爱的劳动。
[来自[url=https://davidhepting.itch.io/the-hobbit-game] itch.io[/url]]
